newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury relaunches chocolates to foil "copy-cats".
newsitem.headline: Cadbury relaunches chocolates to foil "copy-cats".

text.p: Chocolate-maker Cadbury relaunched one of its leading products with patented packaging to deter supermarket chains from launching "copy cat" products, a design company said on Monday.

"Cadbury's brand Milk Tray brand has a radical new design and has been patented because we have been able to prove that no other company has used this shape before," said Amanda Connolly, managing director of Coley Porter Bell, the company responsible for the new design.
The boxed chocolate brand now comes in a box with curved edges.
Look-alike brands are appearing more and more frequently on British supermarket shelves and include everything from breakfast cereals to soft drinks.

Connolly said that in the past some companies had launched box chocolates which hinted at the old Cadbury Milk Tray design but she said they would not be able to copy the new packaging because the patent is in place.
The redesign is also meant to give Milk Tray a more upmarket image and position it as an alternative gift to flowers.
